sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of 'Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse' lies its core gameplay mechanics. The game is an action-packed shooter that challenges you to survive in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Your mission is simple yet complex: complete levels and survive as long as possible. The game features a range of guns, grenades, and other items that you can use to take down the undead.

The controls are simple yet effective, with WASD keys controlling player movement and the mouse used for aiming and shooting. The game also features a range of items and upgrades that you can collect and use to enhance your gameplay experience. From health packs to ammo upgrades, there's plenty to keep you busy as you navigate the world.

One of the things that sets 'Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse' apart from other browser games is its procedurally generated levels. This means that each level is unique, with different layouts, zombie spawns, and item locations. This adds to the game's replay value, making it a great choice for anyone who enjoys a challenge.

But the game's core gameplay mechanics are not just about shooting and surviving - they're also about strategy and planning. With limited ammo and health, you'll need to use your wits to outsmart the zombies and complete each level. From luring zombies into traps to using the environment to your advantage, there's plenty to keep you busy as you navigate the world.
